<!-- overview:start -->

## Overview

Reusable workflow that validates private referentials and updates the public
meetup issue form when the checked-out projection is stale.

### Permissions

- **`contents`**: `read`

<!-- overview:end -->
<!-- usage:start -->

## Usage

```yaml
name: Update meetup issue form
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
permissions: {}
jobs:
  update-meetup-issue-form:
    uses: cloud-native-aixmarseille/meetup-event-automation/.github/workflows/update-meetup-issue-form.yml@1f22000828caf59f41d0a7d8815e5c5c0d3139f6 # 2.3.0
    permissions:
      contents: read
    secrets:
      # PEM-encoded private key for the GitHub App identified by the github-app-client-id input. Used to mint a narrowly scoped installation token.
      # This input is required.
      github-app-private-key: ""
    with:
      # Language for generated reports and guidance (en or fr). Regional variants are supported; unsupported locales fall back to English.
      # This input is required.
      locale: ""

      # GitHub App client ID used to mint the narrowly scoped installation token for meetup automation.
      # This input is required.
      github-app-client-id: ""
```

<!-- usage:end -->
